toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Naam van sy eie' follows English 'a name of his own'; ''n eie naam' is the natural Afrikaans form, shorter and same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'n naam van sy eie' copies the English 'a name of his own'
toegepas.rede_keurder: ''n eie naam' is the natural Afrikaans form, shorter, with the same meaning, and the right stays unconditional.

vlae.teks: 'n Reg is nog so iets wat jy kry sonder om dit te verdien. Party regte kry jy omdat jy 'n mens is
vlae.rede: Rights lesson: the study text states as fact that you GET a right ('wat jy kry', 'kry jy'), while the glossary entry says 'wat jy moet kry' and the Grondwet block says some children do not get food or a home. Not changed because it touches meaning and the parallel with the name sentence; a person or the writer should decide whether 'kry' should be 'moet kry' here.

vlae.teks: Die wet vra dat 'n kind se geboorte gewoonlik binne 30 dae by die regering geregistreer word.
vlae.rede: Read literally, the law asks that a birth 'usually' be registered within 30 days, which is odd logic; the softening seems meant for what happens in practice. 'gewoonlik' is protected, so not changed; the writer may want to check what the qualifier attaches to.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die reg op gesondheid en op kos
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: genoeg kos om van te groei
laat_vaar_vorige.na: genoeg kos sodat hy kan groei
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'om van te groei' is a stiff, English-shaped construction; 'sodat hy kan groei' reads naturally at Grade 4.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'kos om van te groei' follows the normal Afrikaans pattern of 'geld om van te lewe', so the change is lateral, and 'sodat hy kan groei' could be read as linking to the right rather than to the food.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'laat' needs a complement here and reads unfinished; 'sonder sorg los' is the natural expression.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'iemand sonder sorg laat' is complete, natural Afrikaans; 'los' is only a more colloquial alternative.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat die reën en die koue kan keer
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat die reën en die koue kan uithou
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A roof 'hou reën en koue uit' in idiomatic Afrikaans; 'keer' sounds like blocking a person.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die reën en die koue keer' is idiomatic, while 'kan uithou' reads first as 'can withstand', which moves the meaning away from keeping the rain and cold out.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat jou regte van jou vra
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: as jy dit nie altyd regkry nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: as jy nie altyd alles regkry nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'dit' has no single antecedent after a list of several duties; 'alles' points at all of them without adding content.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: This sentence must keep its exact meaning; 'dit' points at the responsibilities just listed, and 'nie altyd alles regkry nie' widens it to getting everything right and shifts the scope of the negation.
